SELECT c.customer_unique_id AS customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.customer_unique_id ASC
LIMIT 10;
